datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2022, classifying geographic areas of Burundi into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity. The spatial data was compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files with attributes including classification scale, collection date, scenario, and assistance eligibility status.
